essence: The mobile sheet should be a transcribe button plus a text area, resizable up to the full sidebar with chat, and look like the desktop sidebar tabs (AI, sessions); streaming into the mobile rail sheet.

One dictation system: the desktop sidebar and the mobile sheet should run the same code with the same cards, processing and refinement; think through what goes where and how dictate, chat and refine nest.
ux/Dictate is strictly AI (voice to text) and could easily move under framework/ai, like ext/AITask; the categorization pass should be careful.
Find why dictation is routed to OpenRouter tokens, restore Claude as intended, and report the current model per dictation path.
Build one shared microphone button with a level meter, placed in the mobile rail and the refine and dictate tabs.
Make the sidebar and mobile sheet run the same dictation code, so desktop and mobile give the same cards, processing, refinement and actions.
Fix chat bubble ordering so statements appear in the order spoken.
Have agents add chat cards and other contextual cards through the built-in page tools, not ad hoc.
Keep the raw Whisper transcript as-is, then run a minimal, robust cleaning pass.
Test chunk boundaries: sentence as baseline, plus commas or pauses and more than four words, avoiding incomplete phrases and using a quicker trigger for long run-ons.
Look into the refinement system and dictate widget, and decide what lives where and how dictate and chat nest together.
Show a prioritized list of past Cloudflare work while transcribing
Make transcription stream in real time instead of batch, and check that it works
Stream transcription in the mobile rail sheet using Whisper
Investigate how the Dictate app manages sessions and why new sessions may not appear
Build permutations of dictation/transcription that simulate real-time streaming, at multiple levels.
Build a live transcribed text area of about three lines, where raw transcription streams in, chunked on sentence periods.
Remove each finished sentence from the text area and send it off, while the next sentence is still transcribing.
Show before/after states of the streaming UI, including half-finished vs finished sentences and each sentence's transition into the refined prompt.
The web voice dictation page is broken; the owner wants to work on fixing it as part of the prompt refinement and chat system (ext/Refine, chat surfaces), not as a standalone fix.
